CommunityApplications.Profile:
Plugins by David Coulson for people running bigger Unraid servers.
- **Docker Search**: a live search box and quick filters (running, healthy, updates, autostart and more) at the top of the Docker tab. Works with folder.view2. - **Storage Topology**: read-only pages showing how your SAS storage and network hardware are wired and how healthy they are: controllers, cables, disk shelves, bays, NICs, transceivers, bonds and LLDP neighbours.
Each plugin has its own support thread on the Unraid forums, linked from its listing. Bugs can also go to the plugin's GitHub issues.
